title: Reading Drill — Keeping a music room cool — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Keeping a music room cool — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The building caretaker in Cairnford received an old report about instruments warming unevenly in a rehearsal room. The report compared temperature variation across stands, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the portable sensors rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered three weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include the number of people rehearsing. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a rearranged storage area as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
